'''grendelX Classic SYCFA Non-flip & Sandspeeders (LS)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 21 February 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8)|VS8O-05-Careful_Planning.png|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Ineffective Maneuver (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-10-Ineffective_Maneuver.png|label=Ineffective Maneuver (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Classic SYCFA Non-flip & Sandspeeders
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 CSNFS grendelX LS 2005 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ineffective Maneuver (V), Careful Planning (V), Bargaining Table (V), Wokling (V), Ardon 'Vapor' Crell, Bo Shek (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), General Dodonna (V), Tawss Khaa (V), Bright Hope (V), Tantive IV (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Dark Side won once to finish 1-3 score 2(-18) for Classic tourney today...

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Aim High (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-aimhigh.gif|label=Aim High}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Battle Plan (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-battleplan.gif|label=Battle Plan}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Do, Or Do Not (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-doordonot.gif|label=Do, Or Do Not}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Ultimatum (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-ultimatum.gif|label=Ultimatum}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-wiseadvice.gif|label=Wise Advice}}

The five cards listed right after Ineffective Maneuver (V) (a starting Effect) are its Defensive Shields, outside the 60.

== Notes ==

* Second deck in GPN post 5933; the Dark deck is on the (DS) page.
* No objective: starts Tatooine, Tatooine: Desert and Jundland Wastes with Ineffective Maneuver (V) and Careful Planning (V).
* Careful Planning (V) and Bargaining Table (V) exist only as Virtual Set 8 printings and are marked (v); dested VS8 (Feb 2005), though the post calls it a Classic tourney.
* Posted Arden "Vapor" Crell dested Ardon 'Vapor' Crell; BoShek (v) dested Bo Shek (V) (VS1).
* Other (V) cards: General Dodonna (V) (VS2); Wokling (V) (VS3); Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V) (VS4); Ineffective Maneuver (V) (VS5); Bright Hope (V) (VS6); Tawss Khaa (V), Tantive IV (V) (VS7).
